theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들

theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트

top_news.title: SEC Delays Crypto Regulation Meeting in Latest Industry Setback
top_news.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission canceled a Friday meeting where the agency was expected to unveil new plans for digital assets as landmark crypto legislation remains stalled in Congress.

top_news.title: Judge Orders Kalshi to Stop Offering Most Wagers in Washington
top_news.summary: Kalshi was told by a judge to stop offering most of its prediction market contracts in Washington state, after regulators said they likely constituted an illegal gambling operation.

top_news.title: Yen Edges Toward 160 Despite Takaichi’s Support for BOJ Hike
top_news.summary: The yen remains within striking distance of a crucial level against the dollar, even after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s government was said to support an interest-rate hike.

top_news.title: NYC Pied-a-Terre Tax Can Proceed for Now, Appeals Court Says
top_news.summary: The rollout of New York’s pied-à-terre tax can proceed for now after an appeals court temporarily put a hold on a Staten Island judge’s order blocking the plan.

top_news.title: Gold Declines as Sliding Inflation Reinforces Fed Hold Bets
top_news.summary: Gold fell below $4,400 an ounce as signs of easing inflation bolstered expectations that the US Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady next month.

top_news.title: Winklevosses’ Gemini Posts Another Loss, Revenue Increases
top_news.summary: Gemini Space Station Inc., the digital-asset platform led by the billionaires Tyler and Cameron Winklevoss that went public last year just before the crypto market tumbled from record highs, posted a fourth consecutive quarterly loss since the IPO.

top_news.title: The Anti-Aging Movement Has Come for Cats and Dogs
top_news.summary: Supplement stacks. Red light therapy. Peptide shots. Many people are biohacking their health to try to live longer, better lives. And now, they’re doing the same for their beloved pets. Anna Edney reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Emerging Market Stocks Hit One-Month High as AI Trade Roars Back
top_news.summary: Emerging-market stocks rose for a second straight session on Thursday, with the index hitting the highest level in more than a month amid a resurgence in the artificial-intelligence trade.

top_news.title: S&P 500 Hits Record as Inflation Cools | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Isabelle Lee, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Fmr. NBA Executive: Lakers a ‘Special Asset’ in Sports
top_news.summary: Bobby Sharma, Founder and Managing Partner at Bluestone Equity Partners, discussed the recent $12.5 billion valuation of the Los Angeles Lakers, highlighting the extraordinary price and the broader trend of sports becoming institutionalized investment assets. Sharma emphasized that the Lakers represent a unique global intellectual property asset, far beyond a local community team, which justifies a scarcity premium. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Isabelle Lee on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg
